header.description: FAM-22 MegaMUD stat-line parser (frmSwingCalc): ParseMegaStatLine, GetMegaStatLine, FirstMegaToken, LastMegaToken, IsMegaPlaceholder, IsMegaWholeNumberToken, CleanMegaNumber, and cmdPasteMega_Click over a clipboard text.
notes: Procedures are cut out of frmSwingCalc.frm (scenario key frm). ParseMegaStatLine is called with ByRef Double/Long outputs (outputs p.refs = [percent, average]) and returns its Boolean.

cmdPasteMega_Click's Clipboard.GetText line is replaced by a read of frmMain.txtClip.Text; its result is the six txtTrueAVG(0..5) texts (empty when nothing was assigned) and a msgbox event for the incomplete-statistics message. An error (Long overflow of an average) is a handled_error event for cmdPasteMega_Click.
Texts are invented stat lines; generated by tools/oracle/gen/mega_stat.py.
